app.name: Community Talks
app.tagline: Your companion app for Swift community events and conferences
app.description: Community Talks is a comprehensive mobile app designed for the Swift developer community to discover, prepare, and engage with talks and conferences.

features.title: Home & Spotlights
features.description: Discover community highlights and featured content.

features.title: Recent Talks
features.description: Explore recent talks from community events.

features.title: Speakers & Conferences
features.description: Browse speaker highlights and conference listings.

features.title: Event Details
features.description: Read an event overview and open its photo album.

features.title: Talk Details
features.description: Find talk descriptions, speakers and related resources.

features.title: Speaker Profile
features.description: Explore a speaker’s profile, links and talks.

features.title: Speaker Directory
features.description: Search and browse the speaker directory.

features.title: Speaking Guide
features.description: Find guidance for preparing and delivering a talk.

features.title: Prepare Talk Content
features.description: Plan your purpose, audience and talk content.

features.title: Talk Delivery
features.description: Explore tips for staying relaxed and delivering a talk.

features.title: Stage Equipment
features.description: Learn about microphones and stage equipment.

features.title: Microphone Etiquette
features.description: Read tips for using a microphone on stage.

features.title: Practice Speech
features.description: Record, play back and rehearse your speech.

features.title: News Notifications
features.description: Set news notification timing, sound and sources.

features.title: System Status
features.description: Check the status of Apple services.

features.title: Developer System Status
features.description: Check the status of Apple developer services.

features.title: Software Releases
features.description: Browse Apple software releases and release notes.

features.title: Roadmap
features.description: Explore planned app features and community ideas.
